module "P_Highlight.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Highlight"
  pipeline order=100 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  parameter "OutlineColor" float4 default=(1, 0.6, 0, 1) group="Look"
  parameter "OutlineWidth" float default=3 group="Look" slider=(1, 8)
  buffer "Mask" R8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1 desc="What the objects cover."
  buffer "Blurred" R8 resolution=Render scale=0.5 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1 export desc="The blurred mask; the ground material reads it too."
  pass "DrawMask" mesh injection=AfterOpaque desc="No depth test: the outline shows through walls."
    material "M_HighlightMask" object=""
    filter Layer(Highlight)
    mesh mode=Override depth=None cull=Auto blend=Replace usage=default nanite=Skip
    write Output0 = Mask
  pass "Blur" compute injection=AfterOpaque
    shader "BoxBlur.usf" virtual="" entry=BlurCS
    threads=(8, 8, 1) (from the shader) dispatch=Blurred * 1
    read Source = Mask
    write Result = Blurred
    param Radius = OutlineWidth * 1 + 0
  pass "Composite" fullscreen injection=BeforePostProcess
    material "PP_OutlineComposite" object=""
    read Mask = Mask
    read Blurred = Blurred
    write SceneColor = SceneColor
    param Color = OutlineColor * 1 + 0
